sn46.30:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sumbhesu viharati setakaṃ nāma sumbhānaṃ nigamo.
sn46.30:1.2: athakho āyasmā udāyī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā udāyī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn46.30:2.2: yāva bahukataṃ ca me bhante, bhagavati pemaṃ ca gāravo ca hiri ca ottappañca.
sn46.30:2.3: ahaṃ hi bhante, pubbe agārikabhūto samāno abahukato ahosiṃ dhammena. abahukato saṅghena.
sn46.30:2.4: so khvāhaṃ bhante, bhagavati pemaṃ ca gāravaṃ ca hiriṃ ca ottappañca sampassamāno agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajiṃ.
sn46.30:2.6: “iti rūpaṃ, iti rūpassa samudayo, iti rūpassa atthagamo,
sn46.30:2.10: iti viññāṇaṃ, iti viññāṇassa samudayo, iti viññāṇassa atthagamo”ti.
sn46.30:3.1: so khvāhaṃ bhante, suññāgāragato imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu ukkujjāvakujjaṃ samparivattento idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ.
sn46.30:3.2: dhammo ca me bhante, abhisamito maggo ca me paṭiladdho,
sn46.30:3.3: yo me bhāvito bahulīkato tathā tathā viharantaṃ tathattāya upanessati. yathāhaṃ
sn46.30:3.4: “khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyā”ti pajānissāmi.
sn46.30:4.1: satisambojjhaṅgo me bhante, paṭiladdho, yo me bhāvito bahulīkato tathā tathā viharantaṃ tathattāya upanessati, yathāhaṃ
sn46.30:4.2: “khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyā”ti pajānissāmi …pe…
sn46.30:4.3: upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo kho me bhante, paṭiladdho yo me bhāvito bahulīkato tathā tathā viharantaṃ tathattāya upanessati, yathāhaṃ
sn46.30:4.4: “khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyā”ti pajānissāmi.
sn46.30:4.5: ayaṃ kho me bhante, maggo paṭiladdho, yo me bhāvito bahulīkato tathā tathā viharantaṃ tathattāya upanessati, yathāhaṃ
sn46.30:4.6: “khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā”ti pajānissāmīti.
sn46.30:5.2: eso hi te udāyi, maggo paṭiladdho, yo te bhāvito bahulīkato tathā tathā viharantaṃ tathattāya upanessati yathā tvaṃ
sn46.30:5.3: “khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyā”ti pajānissasīti.
